item.title: PU Leather Pouch Bag - Travel Jewelry
item.description:
Custom PU Leather Pouch Bag - Travel Jewelry is developed for international brands, importers, retailers, distributors and promotional buyers. The reference product helps buyers compare styling and intended use while final material, dimensions, color, decoration and packing are confirmed for each order.

Please send order quantity, finished dimensions or size range, material requirement or reference sample, colors, logo artwork and placement, packing, destination, Incoterm and target delivery date. These details allow Tendlyn Studio to confirm feasibility, sampling, MOQ, price and production timing in writing.
